\[
\begin{aligned}
I_z
&=\int \rho r^2\,dV\\
&=\iiint_{\Delta V}\rho r^2\,dV\\
&=\Delta z\iint_{\Delta S}\rho r^2\,dS\\
&=\Delta z\iint_{\Delta S}\rho(x^2+y^2)\,dS\\
&=\Delta z\int_{\Delta L}\rho
\left[\frac{2}{3}x^3+xy^2\right]_{-\Delta x/2}^{\Delta x/2}\,dL\\
&=\Delta z\int_{\Delta L}\rho
\left(\frac{1}{12}\Delta x^3+\Delta x y^2\right)\,dL\\
&=\rho\Delta z
\left[\frac{1}{12}\Delta x^3\Delta y+\frac{1}{12}\Delta x\Delta y^3\right]_{-\Delta y/2}^{\Delta y/2}\\
&=\frac{\rho}{12}\Delta x\Delta y\Delta z(\Delta x^2+\Delta y^2)
\end{aligned}
\]
